summary: Banner Corporation filed an 8-K reporting that the Federal Reserve waived the application requirement for its pending merger with Pacific Financial Corporation, the last regulatory approval needed. The parties expect to close the merger on September 1, 2026, subject to customary conditions. The merger was agreed on April 30, 2026, under which Pacific Financial will merge into Banner. A joint press release was issued August 17, 2026. The filing does not disclose financial terms, premiums, or advisors. The deal is in its final pre-close stage; watch for closing conditions satisfaction and potential deal termination risk.
